description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `angular-imported-as-a-namespace` is refused by `style-source/decorator-under-another-name`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: over `_reference`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `logical`, a case that fired another check; with `rule` set to `decorator-unseen`, a case that fired another rule.
